title: LeanForth elaboration data, format version 1: one line
description: Every line of an elaboration-data file (plan row FE1d; ADR 0021 D10), written by scripts/export-elab.sh with pinned Lean 4.35.0 for a Lean export and read by `leanforth check --elab-data FILE` (src/front/elab-data.fs). Line 1 is the header ({"elab_data": ...}); every later line is one record: an instance, a default instance, a reducibility status or an eliminator. A name is the array of its parts, root first (Nat.add is ["Nat","add"]); a part is a string or a natural number. Documented in docs/programming/ELABORATION_DATA.md. The Forth reader also refuses what a schema cannot say: a header anywhere but on line 1 or a record on line 1, a name that is not exactly one declaration of the export or of the wrong kind, a declaration named twice, two eliminators of one kind for the same types, numbers of records or a SHA-256 of the records that differ from the header, another export's SHA-256, and repeated keys.
$comment: Uses only the keywords that tests/support/schema_subset.py implements.

name.description: A Lean name: its parts, root first, each a string or a natural number below 2^32 (a larger part names no declaration of an export LeanForth reads).

export_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the Lean export the data belongs to, as its manifest records it.

records.description: The records of each kind on the lines that follow.

records_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of every line after the header, each with its line feed.

instance.description: An instance (Lean's instance attribute): the declaration, its class (an inductive type), its priority and the order in which its arguments are synthesized.

default_instance.description: A default instance (Lean's default_instance attribute): its class, the instance and its priority.

reducibility.description: A declaration whose reducibility status (Lean's getReducibilityStatus) is not the default, semireducible.

eliminator.description: A custom eliminator: induction for @[induction_eliminator], cases for @[cases_eliminator]; the eliminator and the head constants of its explicit targets' types, Lean's key.
